distinctUnusedConsumer.name: Publish an already-proven raw full-content match to the separate CRC witness array after deduplication
distinctUnusedConsumer.sourceProof: Native raw_term_content_tokens_equal proves glossary length and full raw equality; recent_match is an earlier completed row. The CRC verifier accepts earlier-row equality witnesses and overwrites them in source order with CRC values. The fused caller currently publishes the grammar-time glossary witness before this later full-content match is known.
distinctUnusedConsumer.minimalConceptOnly: If an ordinary recent full-content match was established and the existing grammar witness was absent, assign its earlier row ID to the separate CRC array only. Do not change local glossary_witness, glossary reuse statistics, probe budget or recent-content streak. Never use canonical content IDs as raw witnesses.

distinctUnusedConsumer.decision: Do not implement for JMdict: all eight production-shaped seven-bank groups fail the existing ratio gate, so no CRC work would be saved. Changing that gate is outside this recommendation.

alreadyConsumedProofs: Grammar-time glossary witnesses already avoid composite validation, copy all three hints, avoid a second glossary equality, copy an existing quick signature when remaining raw fields match, and reuse CRC when the unchanged route admits it.
The ordinary recent full-content match already reuses all four content metadata words and unique-content index, avoiding token encoding, content hashing and canonical content equality.
Adjacent bounded equal raw keys already reuse earlier validated string indexes; reading aliases already reuse the current expression index.

The ae886 candidate separately consumes complete suffix equality for numeric values and ordinary content matching; numeric-only grammar/token-end alternatives overlap the prior #735/#761/#899/#972 work.

priorHeaderOrderReceipt.decision: Drop before product implementation: only 73,244 modeled source-SIMD bytes per operand saved across the corpus, with 23,006 more equality calls. No prototype, benchmark, performance PR, or speedup conclusion.
